title: Daily Devotional #55
paragraphs: As I read through Luke 11 today, I am struck by the importance of prayer in our lives. In this chapter, you teach us how to pray and encourage us to ask for what we need.

You start by teaching us the Lord's Prayer, a prayer that many of us have known since childhood. But as I read through it again today, I am reminded of how powerful these words are. When we pray, "Thy will be done," we acknowledge that your plan for our lives is greater than our own. And when we ask for "daily bread," we acknowledge our dependence on you for all of our needs.

Later in the chapter, you tell the parable of the friend who goes to his neighbor at midnight to ask for bread. The neighbor is initially reluctant to get out of bed and help his friend, but eventually gives him what he needs because of his persistence. Through this story, you remind us that we should never give up in prayer. Even when it seems like our requests are going unanswered, we should continue to ask and seek, trusting that you will provide for us in your own time.

As I reflect on these teachings, I am reminded of how important it is to make prayer a priority in my life. It is easy to get caught up in the busyness of everyday life and forget to spend time in conversation with you. But when we make prayer a regular part of our routine, we open ourselves up to your guidance and provision.
Thank you for the reminder today, Lord. Help me to always seek your will and to trust in your provision, even when the answers to my prayers are not what I expect.
